title: mirabilis bracteosa
intro: Mirabilis bracteosa, commonly known as the 'Desert Four O'Clock', is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Nyctaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis bracteosa include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in Mirabilis bracteosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
